remarks: Enjoy the wonderful views of Chautauqua Lake from this home in the lakeside community of Sunrise Cove.  There is a dock and boat slip available through the Sunrise Cove HOA. The dock is close to the house just one level down. Other amenities include the lakeside clubhouse which is available for events with a firepit and grill, a kayak launch, and a tennis & pickleball court. This friendly community has annual social events. Chautauqua Lake offers year-round recreation. Enjoy the many local attractions such as Rails to Trails, Panama Rocks, two ski areas, the National Comedy Center and more. Chautauqua Institution is close by offering summer concerts and programming. Affordable lakefront living at its best with the lake access for boating. There are lake views from almost every room! Gather with friends in the open living room, kitchen and dining room that open to the porch. The porch has both covered and uncovered sections making it a great space for both sunny and rainy days. There is a spacious main living area that provides a large gathering space for hosting get togethers. The kitchen island has room for casual dining and meal prep with the extended two-tiered countertop to separate this space from the living room and dining room. The main floor has a primary bedroom with windows facing the lake and an en-suite bathroom with both a tub and walk-in shower. There is a second bedroom on the main level and full bath for guests. The spacious lower level includes a family room and two more bedrooms, plus a full bathroom. The family room has wet bar and new vinyl plank flooring. Two of the bathrooms were updated with new tile flooring, vanities and fixtures. Along the backside of the house in the lower level is a large unfinished storage area with room for a workshop. Just inside the garage entrance is a combined mudroom and laundry on the main level. This home has lots of storage with all the closet space. The attached two car garage provides storage for your water toys. Conveniently located to I86 and centrally located on the lake making it easy to enjoy Chautauqua, Bemus Point, Lakewood and more. Chautauqua Lake is a great place to call home all year!
